evidence.detail: Ninja perf fix: removed rs.overlooked_decks() from edit_rules() — partial improvement only
edit_rules() still calls num_classified_decks, num_decks, doubled_decks, mistagged_decks, load_all_rules, load_archetypes, excluded_archetype_info — all blocking on each GET
cache_all_rules() (triggered on cache miss) runs the expensive apply_rules_query INSERT against all decks; the issue's 5-second INSERT is still the underlying bottleneck

triage.notes: bakert's comments in the issue identify the root cause (INSERT INTO _applied_rules with full-table scan taking 5s) and suggest a React async rewrite as the proper fix; that is a significant undertaking. The overlooked-decks removal was a workaround, not a resolution.
